newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs to consolidate, look towards 130.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs to consolidate, look towards 130.00.

text.p: June BTP futures look set to consolidate on Monday but the market remains bullish longer term and is still eyeing the 130.00 level, technical analysts said.

"We should see a bit of a consolidation back under the figure from here short-term, but it should be pretty well supported under there," said Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC futures in London.
"The picture is pretty constructive and I think the chances are we will move higher and trade up towards the 130.00 level."
By 0809 GMT June BTPs were at 129.00, down 0.30 from the prior close.
Analysts said 130.00 remained a psychological resistance level for BTPs, and had proved impenetrable last week. Above there, the February 18 high of 130.20 was pegged as resistance.
"I see the trading range between 129.15,20 to 130.00,20, but for the time being I don't expect to be able to take 130.20 successfully," said Daniel Castelnuovo at Banca Euromobiliare in Milan.
Ahead of 130.00, resistance was seen at 129.40, with support coming in around 128.85.

"Along this range I think we will see some light selling by those who have bought around the level of 126.00 and some buying from the latecomers to the marketplace who have missed the 127.50 to 128.00 range," Castelnuovo said.
By 0837 GMT, the June Eurolire contract had edged down one basis point to trade at 93.23.
